description: This file implements network interface and address management functionalities, including platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems. It handles network interface enumeration, address addition/removal, route management, and network status updates, with classes and methods for iterating over network interfaces and addresses, and for interacting with system network configurations.
external_files: <windows system headers like iphlpapi.h, winsock2.h> (on Windows)

classes.name: IPNode
classes.description: Represents an IP address node with associated subnet mask.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: Represents a network node identifier, supporting IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Represents a network interface, providing methods to query and modify its state, addresses, and routes.

classes.name: RoutingTable
classes.description: Represents a system routing table, capable of retrieving route entries.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Represents a single route entry in the routing table.

classes.name: IPNetworks
classes.description: Singleton class managing network interfaces and addresses, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and POSIX.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for enumerating network adapters and their properties.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Observer class for monitoring network adapter events and status changes.

methods.name: ConvertMACToString
methods.description: Converts a MAC address byte array to a string representation with delimiters.

methods.name: LoadAdapterInfo
methods.description: Loads network adapter information for a given adapter index (Windows specific).

methods.name: Address
methods.description: Returns the IP address at a specific index for an adapter (Windows specific).

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an IP address to a network interface (POSIX implementation).

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes an IP address from a network interface (POSIX implementation).

methods.name: Gateway
methods.description: Sets a gateway for a network or route (platform-specific, not implemented).

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates network interface properties based on netlink messages (POSIX).
